text_simplified: Al-ʿaqeedah (creed) and iman are the foundation upon which righteous deeds are built. If the foundation is sound, the fruits will be sound. It is essential to instill the correct ʿaqeedah and sound iman in the hearts of children from a young age, as mentioned in the advice of Luqman to his son, warning him against shirk.
